io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.description:
Shop everyday essentials with your AI agent—and keep the final say. CartRelay helps your connected agent discover live products, compare source-reported prices and availability, and bring you exact product options to review. Missing source details stay visible as unknown, and returned currencies stay as supplied.

Your agent prepares a review-ready shopping list. You review the exact items and quantities, then decide whether to continue to the retailer. CartRelay’s checkout-handoff tool requires your independent approval and a fresh check of the selected offers. Retailers handle checkout, payment, shipping and returns. CartRelay never places orders or processes payments.

The current catalog provider is Shopify Global Catalog, with Canadian-context discovery. Currency preferences are not conversions, and retailers confirm shipping eligibility and final checkout details.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.tagline: Let your agent find the options. Keep the final say.
